mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month (from t-2mo to t-1mo) reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discounting, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST falling below 1150.0 thousand units signals weakening residential construction activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending momentum.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1150.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth to generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO rising above 110.0 in early-cycle expansion regimes indicates strengthening manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises above 110.0 in early-cycle expansion regimes but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) relative to the prior quarter signals expanding economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through momentum-driven market participation.
failure_condition: GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising above 215.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 215.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal monetary tightening in response to inflation, reducing equity valuation multiples and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 5.0% in labor market tightness regimes signals strong employment conditions, increasing consumer disposable income and corporate profit growth to generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE is below 5.0% in labor market tightness regimes but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.
